intro: I'm Rahatul Ananto, an HRI researcher interested in the different ways people experience robots.
perspective: People do not experience robots in the same way. What feels intuitive, helpful, or appropriate to one person may feel unexpected or uncomfortable to another. My research examines these differences and asks what they reveal about how we design robotic systems.

education.title: PhD research · Human–Robot Interaction
education.description: Behavioral diversity, social appropriateness, telepresence, and inclusive human–robot interaction.
